steps.note: Dosed aseptically after the UHT treatment, 0.2–0.6 g per litre through a 0.2 µm sterile filter.

steps.name: hydrolyse
steps.note: Lactose is split into glucose and galactose in the package during ambient storage.

processing.text: For a more neutral taste part of the lactose is first taken out by ultrafiltration; no heat step follows the lactase.
